evidence: Every declared server route reaches an authentication or authorization check somewhere in its call path
expected_output: One observation row per route with route, file, line, auth_reached, auth_symbol, path (the call chain as the artifact), path_resolution (exact|inferred)

assertions.description: Every declared route reaches an authentication check in its call path (recursive CTE over graph.db).

notes: Live as of M4: route nodes are extracted from the code (express-style registrations), and reaches(route, authCheck) is answered by recursive CTE over calls/handles edges. Auth detection is a name heuristic (default: /auth/i) — override with graph.authPatterns in rampscan.config.json. A repo with no detected routes stays honestly unevidenced, never vacuously evidenced.
